name: Pure Angel -Tatta Hitotsu no Negai no Tame ni-
original_name: Pure Angel −たったひとつの願いのために−
source:
Main character is driven out of the dormitory and has to stay at a cafe with a condition to help around the place. Several girls already stay and work here as well. Girl in maid uniform asks to rely on her in everything... what's her motivation?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被赶出了宿舍，只能住在一家咖啡馆，条件是要帮忙周围的一切。一些女孩也已经留在这里工作。穿着女仆装的女孩要求凡事依靠她……她的动机是什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
